role: The /defaultgamemode command: sets the server's default game type and, when force-gamemode is on, re-applies it to every online player.
scope_reason: Commands are off in our survival worlds (DEVLOG 2026-09-25); the world's game type is fixed by the harness and the tape header, not chat commands.

members.name: setGameType
members.note: MinecraftServer.setGameType plus the force-gamemode player sweep

notes: Extends CommandGameMode (getGameModeFromCommand comes from there); that parent is indexed under its own record.
